features.description: show every machine and whether it is free, running, done, or out of order

complaints.missing: Spin Cycle Status doesn't even list the machines. What is it for.
complaints.down: Spin Cycle Status said every machine was free. Walked over anyway. All busy.
complaints.wrong: Spin Cycle Status said machine 3 was free. It was out of order. It's always out of order.
complaints.six_of_eight: Spin Cycle Status shows 6 machines. There are 8.
complaints.done_as_free: Spin Cycle Status said a machine was free. Someone's wet laundry was still in it.
complaints.broken_as_free: Spin Cycle Status said machine 3 was free. It was out of order. It's always out of order.
complaints.failed_fetch: Spin Cycle Status said every machine was free. None were.
complaints.raw_codes: Spin Cycle Status says M5 is "1". One what.

bugs.when: The site shows only 6 machines, the first page of the feed, instead of all of them.
fixed: The site reads every page of the feed now, so all the machines show.
It was stopping after the first page. All machines show now.

bugs.when: Machines that are done (laundry still inside) show as free.
fixed: Done machines show as done now, not free.
Fixed done machines showing as free.
Out-of-order machines show as out of order now.
Fixed broken machines showing as free.

bugs.when: The site shows the raw status codes (0, 1, 2, 3) instead of free, running, done and out of order.
fixed: The status codes are translated to free, running, done and out of order now.
No more raw codes. Each machine shows its status in words.

checklist.text: ST 0 free, 1 running, 2 done, 3 out of order

features.description: refresh the live status regularly instead of showing stale data

complaints.no_refresh: Spin Cycle Status said 4 machines free. Walked over, all 4 running. The page hadn't updated since the morning.

bugs.when: The machine status never refreshes; it stays as it was when the page loaded.
fixed: The status refreshes on its own now.
Fixed the refresh. The page stays current.
